name: nszpc-manager
description: 星辰電腦 NSZPC 管理系統

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply nszpc-dpom --local && wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler d1 migrations apply nszpc-dpom --remote && wrangler deploy
